title: AI Transformation with Microsoft Copilot
tagline: Practical technology training for the work you do
hook: Plan, secure, integrate and measure Copilot at work
marketing_pitch: Turn Microsoft Copilot from isolated prompts into a controlled business improvement programme. Build an implementation plan, test security gates, design an agent workflow, and measure pilot value using evidence your stakeholders can review.
description: AI Transformation with Microsoft Copilot equips participants to plan, design, implement and evaluate AI-powered solutions using Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Power Platform and connected business workflows. Learners work with organisational data, files and application context while preserving privacy and security. They design custom agents, prompts and integrations; test output quality, prompt injection and sensitive-data exposure; and use telemetry and ROI measures to decide whether to scale. Synthetic cases and structured labs keep practical evidence separate from live customer data.
learning_outcomes: Develop technology implementation plans and business processes for Microsoft Copilot.
Develop control procedures for Microsoft Copilot to manage security.
Evaluate the integration of Microsoft Copilot to ensure alignment with business objectives.
Develop optimization plans for Microsoft Copilot to improve business operations.

topics.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Implementation and Business Process Transformation
Microsoft Copilot Administration, Security and Responsible AI
Copilot Integration, AI Agents and Cross-Platform Workflows
AI Optimization, Performance Monitoring and Business Value Assessment

mode: Physical classroom or synchronised Zoom; corporate training available
venue: 12 Woodlands Square #07-85/86/87, Woods Square Tower 1, Singapore 737715
assessment: Written assessment and practical performance assessment, one hour each, individual open book
who_should_attend: Business transformation, operations, IT, security and process owners who need evidence-led Copilot adoption and control decisions.
certification: Certificate of Achievement from Tertiary Infotech Academy and, on meeting WSQ assessment and attendance requirements, SkillsFuture Singapore Statement of Attainment via OpenCerts.
